item.title: Testing Oracle Database Connection In Java
item.description:
Testing Oracle Database Connection in Java

If you are working with Oracle databases and Java, establishing a reliable connection is essential. This guide will demonstrate how to test a connection to an Oracle database using Java code.

Prerequisites

Before proceeding with connection testing, ensure the following prerequisites are met:

  • Java Development Kit (JDK) installed on your machine.
  • Oracle JDBC driver added to your Java project.
